accepted.s: The foundation for replacing the gates of the Sir Arthur Cotton Barrage was laid on which date?
accepted.x: The foundation for replacing the gates of the Sir Arthur Cotton Barrage was laid on 13 July 2026.
accepted.tq: Use precise date discrimination among closely related alternatives.

accepted.s: How many gates of the Sir Arthur Cotton Barrage are proposed to be replaced?
accepted.x: The project involves replacing 117 gates of the Sir Arthur Cotton Barrage.
accepted.tq: Check the exact numerical figure rather than relying on approximate similarity.

accepted.s: The estimated cost of replacing the gates of the Sir Arthur Cotton Barrage is:
accepted.x: The estimated cost of the gate-replacement project is ₹152.95 crore.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the exact project cost from nearby numerical distractors.

accepted.s: By which time is the replacement of the 117 gates of the Sir Arthur Cotton Barrage scheduled to be completed?
accepted.x: The gate-replacement work is scheduled for completion by July 2028.
accepted.tq: Separate the completion deadline from alternative years and months.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Sir Arthur Cotton Barrage:
1. Its length is 5.837 kilometres.
2. It was rebuilt in 1969.
3. It irrigates approximately 10 lakh acres.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: the barrage is 5.837 kilometres long, was rebuilt in 1969, and irrigates about 10 lakh acres.
accepted.tq: Verify each numerical statement independently before selecting the combined option.

accepted.s: What was the discharge recorded from the Sir Arthur Cotton Barrage during the floods of July 2026?
accepted.x: During the July 2026 floods, the barrage discharged over 5.2 lakh cusecs.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact discharge figure and retain the stated unit of cusecs.

accepted.s: Automated crest-gate telemetry and SCADA were installed at which barrage in February 2026?
accepted.x: Automated crest-gate telemetry and SCADA were installed at the Prakasam Barrage in February 2026.
accepted.tq: Apply the location-and-year pair to distinguish similar irrigation structures.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the significance of the Godavari and Krishna deltas in Andhra Pradesh?
o: They are known as the Cotton Bowl of Andhra.
They are known as the Mineral Bowl of Andhra.
They are known as the Rice Bowl of Andhra.
They are known as the Industrial Bowl of Andhra.
accepted.x: The Godavari and Krishna deltas are collectively known as the “Rice Bowl of Andhra” because of their importance for rice cultivation.
accepted.tq: Match the distinctive regional title with the correct geographical area.
